message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.remind: Something is missing from my palm.
Let me see those golden edges again.
One turn, and my mind will settle.
I remember its comforting weight.
I will take it out when this is done.
That light should still be in my pocket.
Will its patterns be different today?
I only want to check that it is still there.
My fingertips remember how it turns.
That little gold is softer than sunlight.
Take a break. Spend a moment with it.
It has never disappointed me.
Perhaps the next face holds the answer.
Has it been too long since I touched it?
I can still see its glow with my eyes closed.
Let me hear that clean little click again.
There is no harm in just holding it.
Why does everything else feel so dull?
I have not finished admiring its six faces.
Do not put it away yet. One more look.
I could focus better with it in my hand.
I want that feeling of safety again.
I know how to make today easier.
Something so beautiful should not be neglected.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.unease: Why does my hand keep reaching for my pocket?
My fingertips are cold. Holding it would help.
I am fine. Just a little restless.
Did I just hear it click?
I have not forgotten anything... have I?
Why do I feel so hollow?
Stop shaking. This is nothing serious.
Time crawls when it is not in my hand.
Clenching my fist cannot hold its warmth.
A little longer. I can wait.
Why did I count everything in my bag again?
Maybe I am just tired.
My eyes keep drifting toward the gold.
A familiar little click is missing.
I should not care this much about a little object.
Leave my pocket alone. I will check it myself.
Where do I put my hands without it?
What did I come here to do?
My chest feels one beat behind.
Check once more. The last time.
How did that comfort disappear so quickly?
I just want my fingers to stop stiffening.
I would feel better if I held it now.
I am not waiting for it. I am only...
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.cravin: Give it to me, and I can finish this sentence.
My knuckles are counting the seconds for me.
Enough. Tell me where it is first.
I searched here already. Why must I search again?
A little piece has been scooped out of my palm.
I need that little click. Now.
I need it. Do you understand me?
Every blink steals another glimpse of its light.
Who touched my things? Who?
Reach out. A little farther.
I promised one touch. I will keep that promise.
Could it be hidden behind that wall?
Stop looking at me. I am only searching.
Everything is wrong. Even breathing feels wrong.
It is not here. Why can I smell metal?
It can all go, as long as the cube returns.
Why did I say that again?
Air slips between my fingers. Something is leaking away.
Please do not make me wait.
I cannot hear you. My head is too loud.
Closer. I think I can see it.
I will not break it. I only need a tighter grip.
Do not block the gold. I am starting to forget.
Did you hear that? It is looking for me too.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.fractu: Was that hand mine a moment ago?
I turned around. It stayed behind my head.
Six faces. Seven faces. Do not count the eighth.
The walls are breathing. I am not.
Its words arrive before my thoughts.
Not here. Not here. Which here is here?
Has a piece fallen out of my name?
Who is begging for it in my voice?
Gold shines through the inside of my eyelids.
Behind the door is the same door.
The second that just passed has come back.
I pulled back my hand. My shadow did not.
Do not trust the quiet person in the mirror.
Its edges are thinking for me.
My memories are turning the wrong way.
I remember I remember I remember... what?
ここにいる。ずっと、ここにいる。
Return it. The corners remember.
Верни куб. Я слышу его.
Mind checksum failed: me / me / it.
Please return the hand I had yesterday.
I can see the sound flowing down its edges.
One more turn will put me back together.
If I close my eyes, it will see for me.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.deliri: Do not stop do not stop. If I stop, I will hear it.
I have six pairs of eyes. Which pair was mine?
My thoughts fell off an edge. Catch them!
The cube is assembling me as I search.
The sky split at its seams. It is gold inside.
Silence it. Silence the sound in my bones!
It has returned. My hands have not arrived yet.
Do not say my name. It will hear you.
The thought on the left is not mine. Neither is the right.
I am inside. Who is using my eyes outside?
Something is folding every second into six pieces.
帰して。私の手を、帰して。
GIVE IT BACK. THERE IS NO OTHER SHAPE.
Я не я. Куб помнит меня.
Reviens. Je ne peux plus attendre.
もう一度、もう一度、もう一度。
Wo sind meine Gedanken?
No puedo pensar. Solo el oro.
Thought out of bounds: gold_gold_gold / no return.
What am I sayi—who turned away the rest of the sentence?
Six faces / six faces / which face is me?
ERROR: self_without_cube not found.
Do not pull out the gold. My mind is attached!
I am not awake. I have simply not been folded shut.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.collap: I have been folded into a face that does not exist.
Every direction leads to the same hand.
Do not separate us. I have no edges left.
It is turning my name. Wrong way. WRONG WAY!
My thoughts fall off in pieces. They are all gold.
I see myself watching myself from another face.
Six is not six. Hands are not hands. I am not—
Only the last face. The last face. The last face...
Who twisted my mind into the seam?
I cannot remember the color of light. Only the cube.
Do not let me come apart. I have not found the center.
A door inside my head keeps turning.
If I disappear, remember to hold it tight.
Its six faces are six awakenings that never end.
I can hear myself crying in another language.
I want to go back. Back has already been turned away.
There is no me here. Only an empty center.
Instruction loop: hold / turn / lose / hold.
memory[ME] = GOLD; GOLD; GOLD;
SELF_NOT_FOUND // RETURN_CUBE
0xSIX_0xNO_SELF_0xRETURN
ME ME ME ME / IT IT IT IT / CHECKSUM FAILED.
ここはどこ？私はどの面？
返して、返して、私を返して！
もう戻れない。金色しかない。
手が、私の手が、動いている。
Я внутри. Выпусти меня.
Нет лица. Нет имени. Только куб.
Он думает вместо меня.
Je suis dans la mauvaise face.
Rends-moi mes pensées !
Ich bin nicht mehr hier.
Sechs Seiten. Keine Rückkehr.
No hay salida. Solo otra cara.
Devuélveme mi nombre.
I AM THE SEAM. DO NOT TURN ME.
THOUGHT LOST // KEEP TURNING
OPEN THE HAND INSIDE MY HEAD.
GOLD GOLD GOLD—whose sentence comes next?
...which face is hiding the end?
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.1: It hurts. Every breath scrapes my bones.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.2: STOP! Something is tearing me open from inside!
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.3: A hand is squeezing my heart.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.4: Every turn takes another piece of me.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.5: My blood is hot. My hands are getting colder.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.6: This is no vision. This pain is real.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.7: My bones are full of sharp edges.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.8: Please pull it out. Stop turning it deeper!
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.9: My chest is splitting. Help me!
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.1: It hurts too much to remember my name.
I can hear my nerves snapping.
I am leaking away. Every drop is me.
The gold is burning through my body.
Do not touch me. Even my shadow hurts.
I only wanted to put it down. Why does it hurt this much?
Every finger is being twisted backward.
Let me breathe. Just one breath.
There is fire inside. I cannot find the burn.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.2: My heartbeat is trapped between two faces.
It hurts... I do not want to come apart again.
Something is peeling down my spine, joint by joint.
Take the corners away. Get them out of my body!
My veins are turning with it.
I cannot hold on to my breath.
My body will disappear before my thoughts do.
I lose another piece every second. Who will catch me?
I do not want the gold anymore. I want the pain to stop.
Do not let me die inside its edges.
message.sakura_mod.golden_whisper.pain.3: NERVE OVERLOAD / PAIN OVERLOAD / CANNOT EXIT.
PAIN PAIN PAIN—thought buffer burned out.
Body response: pain / pain / pain / infinity.
HEART_ERR // I AM STILL INSIDE // HELP
痛い、痛い！もう回さないで！
